mapper.select: select id, `name`, `play_count` playCount,`like_count` likeCount,collect_count collectCount,`content`, `video_url` videoUrl, `video_cover` videoCover, `del_status` delStatus, `create_time` createTime, `update_time` updateTime, drama_id dramaId from t_video where del_status = 1 and status = 1 ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 5;
mapper.update: update t_video set `like_count` = `like_count` - 1 where `id` = #{id} and like_count > 0
update t_video set `collect_count` = `collect_count` - 1 where `id` = #{id} and collect_count > 0
mapper.select: select series_name as seriesName, max(video_cover) as cover, count(1) as episodeCount, sum(play_count) as playCount from t_video where status = 1 and del_status = 1 and series_name is not null and series_name != '' and (`name` like concat('%', #{name}, '%') or series_name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')) group by series_name order by max(create_time) desc

select v.id, v.`name`, v.video_url as videoUrl, v.video_cover as videoCover, v.content, v.play_count as playCount, v.episode_num as episodeNum, v.series_name as seriesName from t_video v inner join ( select series_name, min(id) as min_id from ( select series_name, id, ROW_NUMBER() over (partition by series_name order by RAND()) as rn from t_video where status = 1 and del_status = 1 and series_name is not null and series_name != '' and video_url is not null and video_url != '' ) ranked where rn = 1 group by series_name order by RAND() ) r on v.id = r.min_id where v.status = 1 and v.del_status = 1

select id, `name`, video_url as videoUrl, video_cover as videoCover, content, play_count as playCount, episode_num as episodeNum from t_video where series_name = #{seriesName} and status = 1 and del_status = 1 order by episode_num is null, episode_num asc, id asc

select v.id from t_video v inner join t_video cur on cur.id = #{videoId} where v.series_name = cur.series_name and v.status = 1 and v.del_status = 1 and v.id not in (select vp.video_id from t_video_publicize vp where vp.user_id = #{userId}) and (coalesce(v.episode_num, 0) > coalesce(cur.episode_num, 0) or (coalesce(v.episode_num, 0) = coalesce(cur.episode_num, 0) and v.id >= cur.id)) order by v.episode_num is null, v.episode_num asc, v.id asc limit #{limit}
